description: Fifteen-minute local API-only VLIW Goal Plus + Codex smoke with two live workers and a provider-validated gpt-5.5 model.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the smoke validates Goal Plus with Codex and two live search workers
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local smoke uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the model is selected from the current endpoint after a real Goal Plus MCP semantic probe
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: reasoning effort is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the Goal Plus wiring smoke uses a fifteen-minute exploration budget
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: Goal Plus maps K to internal workers in one outer trajectory
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the campaign reserves capacity for two task cells while this preset contains one VLIW cell
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
protocol_override_reasons.eval_interval: the smoke evaluates once per minute so it records hidden-Judge evidence
protocol_override_reasons.internet: all Agent execution is restricted to the Judge and the dynamically resolved LLM API endpoint
